description.zh: 最后开按钮。导入语句在上面，变体尺寸加载在下面。 原 NextUI，YC S24 开源 React 组件库，把 React Aria 与 Tailwind CSS v4 拼成无障碍组件，npm 包 @heroui/react；核心包 MIT，HeroUI Pro 模板另售。
description.en: 原 NextUI，YC S24 开源 React 组件库，把 React Aria 与 Tailwind CSS v4 拼成无障碍组件，npm 包 @heroui/react；核心包 MIT，HeroUI Pro 模板另售。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by HeroUI (https://heroui.com/).
Technology stack: react, react-native, tailwind, typescript.
Component specification: 最后开按钮。导入语句在上面，变体尺寸加载在下面。
Key visual & interaction patterns: Tooltip、Dialog、Checkbox、Combobox.
Visual details from source observation: 我们进去先看首页默认好看那句，GitHub 仍写 Previously NextUI。组件目录按按钮、浮层分栏，按钮、模态框都有预览图。我们点开按钮：先看导入语句，下面是变体、尺寸和加载。适合要无障碍行为加 Tailwind 默认样式的人。核心包可免费装；模板要去 Pro，别和开源库混成一份。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Core @heroui/react is free MIT; HeroUI Pro templates are a separate paid offering
